### Changes

- Fix drag and drop after a Windows update, and restore saved conversion options and filenames when editing queued tasks.
- Prompt for Android updates when idle and keep the version badge visible during conversion.
- Speed up AVIF encoding and improve large AVIF decoding on the Web.
- Remove the manual peak control and the Rec.709 export option. Ultra HDR JPEG continues to use automatic peak estimation.
- Add CLI controls for AVIF encoder speed and JPEG XL effort.
